title: Pricing plan comparison
description: A plan selection page with 2-4 plan columns, a billing-period switch, a recommended plan marked with a reason, and a full feature comparison table below grouped by capability. Prices show currency, period, and what is billed per seat or usage.
intent: Help a buyer pick the right plan quickly and verify the details before paying, without hidden conditions.
characteristics: plan columns with name, price, billing basis, and one-line audience
monthly/annual switch with the saving stated as a number
one recommended plan with a reason, not just a badge
grouped comparison table with sticky plan header
FAQ for billing questions under the table
interaction: Billing switch is a segmented control that updates all prices at once. Plan actions are links or buttons with the plan name in their accessible name. Comparison rows can expand to explain a feature.
responsive: Plan columns stack on narrow screens with the recommended plan first; the comparison table switches to one plan at a time with a plan picker rather than horizontal scroll of all columns.
accessibility: Comparison is a real table with row and column headers; included/excluded marks have text alternatives; price changes from the switch are announced politely; no information conveyed by strike-through alone.
limitations: More than four plans needs a different pattern (configurator or contact sales).
Requires actual prices and terms; never invent discounts or customer counts.
